hypothesis: Source and scorer checks, plus exact known-key recovery on every control when the 76-letter 5x7 control is searched exhaustively instead of annealed, permit a calibrated full-text transposition search of QTXMA that exceeds its matched complete-search null.
refuted_by: Source or scorer checks fail, a known-key control fails exact recovery, or the target maximum fails matched complete-search calibration (empirical p above 0.05). The target is expected to fail calibration; see predictions.
limitations: The published count corpus may overlap with some solved messages used for validation; message-level training membership is not documented.
The source form confirms group boundaries but does not establish word boundaries or a cipher procedure.
This remains a bounded search over ordinary double columnar transposition with ragged final rows.
The historical Phase 6 baseline is preserved for comparison, not reused as validation.

Rotation-aware accuracy credits a recovery that is correct up to a whole-row shift the stage geometry can produce; the exact-offset agreement and exact key recovery are recorded separately so the two cases stay distinguishable.
The known-key controls are constructed or independently solved plaintexts, not authentic held-out Army traffic; they test the search and scorer, not corpus representativeness.

The only change from v2 is the exhaustive limit. A control that passes now passes because the search is exhaustive over its 604,800 states, which says the scorer and the convention are right and the annealing budget was too small; it says nothing about annealed pairs, of which 7x7 remains (25.4 million states, no control at that size).
Exhaustive search finds each pair's best-scoring key under this scorer, so a target maximum that clears the null would still be a score and not a plaintext.
revision_rationale: v2 failed its independent 5x7 control and gated off the target search. The failure was not the row-filling convention: scoring all 604,800 key pairs ranks the known key first and the one-character-rotated reading second, and the recorded search anneals 12,008 of them (2%) because 604,800 exceeds the inherited max_exhaustive_states of 20,000 (docs/phase7-experiment-history.md, correction of 2026-10-11). v3 changes only that limit, to 604,800, so the 5x7 and 7x5 pairs are searched exhaustively, in controls and target alike. Nothing else differs from v2: the controls, scorer, seeds, width pairs and calibration are v2's. The 7x7 pair, 25,401,600 states, is still annealed.

additional_positive_controls.rationale: Length 133 is a multiple of neither stage width, so both stages have ragged final rows and no whole-row rotation of the plaintext can be produced by an alternative key. A failure here is a genuine scorer or optimizer failure rather than the rotation degeneracy that invalidated the v1 control reading.

predictions.statement: All three known-key controls (4x5 148 letters, 4x5 ragged 133 letters, 5x7 76 letters) recover the plaintext and the key exactly, so the target search is not gated off. Decides whether the run reaches the target.

QTXMA's selected full-text score does not clear the complete-search null (empirical p above 0.05, status not_supported_under_search_calibrated_null). Expected because phase5's conservation gate excludes a transposition of German Army plaintext for QTXMA. This prediction decides the hypothesis: its failure supports it.

decision_rule: Controls fail: report which, and stop; nothing is inferred about QTXMA. Controls pass and the target fails calibration (expected): the transposition path for QTXMA is closed by search as well as by conservation, and no further transposition width search is warranted. Controls pass and the target clears calibration: that contradicts the conservation gate, so it is treated as a scorer or null artifact until the key and a readable plaintext are reproduced independently and the gate's exclusion is re-examined. It is not an accepted break either way.

pre_run_facts.disclosure: Known before this configuration was written. None of it is a result of this run.
pre_run_facts.diagnosis: The 5x7 control's failure under v2 was diagnosed on 2026-10-11 (phase7 history, correction). Scoring all 604,800 key pairs with this scorer ranks the known key first (-6.7018 per letter) and the rotated reading second (-6.7145). Run through phase6.evaluate_positive_control with max_exhaustive_states 604800 the control passed with the exact key and plaintext (604,800 evaluations, 27 s). So that control's outcome under this limit is already known, and it is a gate here, not a test.
pre_run_facts.target_not_searched: QTXMA has not been searched with this machinery: v2 gated it off and no engineering run touched its ciphertext. Evaluation cost was timed on random 155-letter text, not on QTXMA's ciphertext, at about 82 microseconds per evaluation.
pre_run_facts.expected_cost: About 1.24 million evaluations per all-width search (2,880 + 2,880 + 14,400 + 604,800 + 604,800 exhaustive, plus 12,008 annealed for 7x7), about 100 s. Three seeds make 3 searches and 19 null replicates make 57 more, about 1.7 hours in one process (the runner is serial), plus about 30 s for the 5x7 control. Exhaustive pairs repeat identically across seeds; only 7x7 depends on the seed.
pre_run_facts.context: QTXMA's letters are not Enigma-like (four letters absent in 155) and phase5's conservation gate excludes a transposition of German Army plaintext. This run does not test that exclusion; it checks the machinery and closes the search by a second route.
